Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.initialization

Class StateInitializationOrchestrator

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.initialization.StateInitializationOrchestrator
@Component("stateInitializationOrchestrator") @Order(1) public class StateInitializationOrchestrator extends Object
Orchestrator for state-specific initialization phases.

This class manages state and search region initialization including: 1. State registration and validation 2. Search region dependency resolution 3. Cross-state reference validation 4. Declarative region setup

This orchestrator works in conjunction with BrobotStartupOrchestrator to handle the state-specific aspects of initialization.

By centralizing state initialization, we ensure: - Proper ordering of initialization steps - Clear visibility into what's being initialized - Single point of control for declarative regions - Easy debugging of state relationships
